svg.title: Two institutions whose own files already held the warning
svg.desc: Dated ledgers of the Enron board record from 1999 to 2002 and the SEC complaint record on Madoff from 1992 to 2009, with the intervals each investigation measured.
svg.text: Two institutions whose own files already held the warning
No single paper stated the conclusion. Each investigation put scattered records into one dated sequence, and the places where two
records disagreed were where the digging started, late.
what the minutes and presentations recorded, 1999 to 2001
hatched bar: three approvals of the LJM partnerships, 1999 and 2000
Finance Committee told of $60 billion in
assets, about $27 billion held by affiliates
dark bar: Raptors, three approvals in 2000
two years from documented board warning to collapse
Directors said the collapse surprised them. The report found the high-risk practices were not hidden from the board. Gross revenues reported to it rose from $40 billion in 1999 to $100
billion in 2000, and apparently no member questioned the figure. The warning was not necessarily public information.
committees; met five times a year
six substantive complaints between June 1992 and December 2008; those dated in testimony are marked
likely, front running unlikely; later versions
eight years: warning on file in 2000, public exposure in 2008
Two examinations ran in different offices at once; neither knew of the other.
Information showing no transaction activity in Madoff’s account was not passed to the
A report that Madoff held no option positions on a date led to no further step.
Later, clearing-entity records for particular dates came nowhere near the volumes he
Inconsistencies can indicate missing variables, incompatible assumptions, errors, or genuine opportunities for explanation.
Sources: U.S. Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations, The Role of the Board of Directors in Enron’s Collapse, July 8, 2002; U.S. Senate
Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs hearing, September 10, 2009. Only dated events stated in the sources are placed; positions
within a year are approximate where only the year is given.
